note: Hand landmarks that MediaPipe 0.10.21 (solutions.hands, default model) found in 65 photographs of hands. The photographs are not part of the repository; only these joint positions are. 'shows' was set by looking at each photograph. 'image' holds x and y as fractions of the frame's width and height ('size', in pixels); 'world' holds MediaPipe's world landmarks in metres. Poses that are not gestures of Nexus (ok_sign, three_fingers, four_fingers, shaka, relaxed) are here to be told apart from them.
